await new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, 800); }); var fr = 0, t0 = performance.now(); var cnt = function(){ fr++; if (performance.now() - t0 < 3500) requestAnimationFrame(cnt); }; requestAnimationFrame(cnt); }); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key:'w', bubbles:true })); await new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, 300); }); B.emitEvent('tw', { k:'recStop' }); await new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, 1500); }); var fps = fr / 3.5; var n0 = window.__plans.length; startExport(); for (var i = 0; i < 400 && window.__plans.length === n0; i++) await new Promise(function(r){ setTimeout(r, 100); }); var p = window.__plans[window.__plans.length - 1]; if (!p) return label + ': NO PLAN ' + JSON.stringify(window.__TW.rec()); var k = p.ids.indexOf('lisx'); var xs = p.frames.map(function(r){ return r[k]; }); var moving = 0, held = 0, runs = [], run = 0; for (var j = 1; j < xs.length; j++){ var d = Math.abs(xs[j] - xs[j-1]); if (d > 1e-6){ moving++; if (run) runs.push(run); run = 0; } else if (moving) { held++; run++; } } var lastMove = 0; for (var j = 1; j < xs.length; j++) if (Math.abs(xs[j]-xs[j-1]) > 1e-6) lastMove = j; var first = -1; for (var j = 1; j < xs.length; j++) if (Math.abs(xs[j]-xs[j-1]) > 1e-6){ first = j; break; } var span = lastMove - first + 1;
